summaryColumnMeaning.governing docs: Count of deduplicated Batch0 document entries associated with this feed, including operative sources, guidance, metadata-only context, explicit reference anchors and open gaps. This is not an operative-source count. The TOTAL row is the union, not the sum of feed counts. Full IDs are in governingDocumentsByFeed.
summaryColumnMeaning.records extracted: Delivered B records, counted once by record ID. Repeated underlying obligations across feeds remain distinct delivered records. No working draft, source text or matrix cell is counted.
summaryColumnMeaning.records with real passages: Nonempty B passages whose existing batch catalogues identify the source as inspected. Stored-text hashes were recomputed; Batch11 is not a fresh full-PDF audit of every passage.
summaryColumnMeaning.records unsourced: B records with missing passages or marked unsourced. Zero does not imply complete source coverage or absence of extraction errors.

guidancePolicy: All 146 guidance records explicitly carry binding:false and kind:guidance; all 1658 operative records carry binding:true with an operative kind. Guidance remains catalogued, not baselined. The pre-existing F1 contract guidance-projection limitation remains separately flagged; no guidance-only sample values were added.

gradingFlags.finding: F1 C includes guidance-only slots rows[].attributes.guidance.performance_value and rows[].attributes.guidance.requirement_type. Its canonicalForm serializes all metadata and rows without an explicit guidance exclusion. Therefore guidance-only values, if supplied in those slots, are not excluded by the declared rule. C correctly makes handbook findings warn-only; this is not a claim that the included sample contains those values or that its digest failed. No baseline hash was recomputed in this B-focused audit.

All 84 F10 B records are from DI-MGMT-81861C (31), incorporated CPD FFS (21), incorporated CPD DEI (3), DI-MGMT-81797 (6), DI-SESS-82538 (9), and DI-MGMT-80004A (14). SEP Outline, SE Guidebook and MIL-STD-881F contributed no operative F10 B records. Guidance facts retained in A are not counted.

The retained A entry for DI-SESS-81785B has an operative-source classification but the same batch explicitly treats it as metadata-only for F10; it contributed zero B records. The reconstruction preserves the conflicting metadata claims rather than counting extra requirements.

Batch0 is reconstructed with user approval from the delivered batch files. Missing edition, title, release or copyright metadata stays unverified. Four F1-only entries have unverified copyrightClass. The five Batch11 reference anchors supply no target clauses. Original section labels and provenance are retained, not newly verified.
All 1,804 B records retain status sample; normalized wordings await human review. Hashes establish normalized text identity, not accuracy, applicability, source authority or approval.

edgeSemantics.implements: Child technical obligation -> represented explicit parent obligation in another document. Parent selection uses the lowest numbered feed for the same clause; all 24 F10 CPD technical children point to DZR-F4-0007. Rev2 explicitly adds 262 same-document NAVAIR criterion-to-review-type-parent edges. These 17 parents retain the common 4b(7)/5e/5f obligation text once per review type.
edgeSemantics.invokes: Source requirement -> canonical document ID in Batch0, only where the inspected source expressly commands use, conformance or required content. A target may be an open gap or metadata-only anchor; the edge does not claim that its contents were inspected or complied with.
edgeSemantics.tailors: Reserved for a source-proven actual tailoring of another document obligation. No such edge was established. A generic permission or unfilled contract choice is insufficient.
edgeSemantics.applicability: CSV is a projection of trace identity only. Each source requirement retains its exact conditions and selected edition. The supporting conditions/evidence/exclusions are retained in _work/final-edge-evidence.json.
edgeSemantics.recordIdentity: Distinct delivered from_id values remain distinct, including F10-0005 and F4-0007 invocation edges. Canonical parent selection does not merge B records or renumber opaque IDs.
edgeSemantics.excluded: No shared-topic, matching-field, bibliography-only, generic framework or source-gap-to-invented-requirement edges. Fifteen DD1423 choices, nine approved DD2794 plan references and two contractor system-description references require actual contract instances. No generic blank form stands in for those unavailable instances.

openGaps.policy: Existing source gaps stay open on every affected feed. No replacement edition, indexed summary or target passage was substituted. Reference-only anchors are separately uninspected, not claimed inaccessible.

F7.matrixTreatment: The matrix remains in the F7 contract; its cells are not baseline requirement records. Retired F7 IDs are absent from current B/C.
F7.criterionPassagePolicy: The 262 criterion source.passage fields contain only the native criterion row text. Common 4b(7)/5e/5f body text is retained in the parent records and linked by implements.
F7.sourceCriterionTerminology: The source labels the rows SETR Entry Criteria; the legacy entranceExitCriteria summary key does not assert that exit-criteria rows were extracted.
F7.countMeaning: 355 B objects comprise 93 governing obligation records and 262 subordinate criterion rows. Binding counts include those conditional criterion rows; they are not 262 additional independent engineering-execution duties.

F7SampleHashRecomputed.reason: Only catalogue governance references changed; complete three-row sample bytes/content remain unchanged.

packetGradingGuide.Batch0: Read governing-documents.csv and mil-hdbk-539a-sections.csv; governing-document-register.json preserves all metadata, source pointers, gaps and aliases.
packetGradingGuide.Batch1: Grade F1-requirement-records.json, F1-data-contract.json and F1-source-audit.json. Other existing F1 baseline/sample/validation files are preserved legacy outputs.
packetGradingGuide.Batches2Through10: Grade top-level A-governing-documents.json, B-requirement-records.json and C-data-contract.json.
packetGradingGuide.Batch11: Read edges.csv, summary.csv, summary-notes.json and sources/ipmdar/source-manifest.json. The five IPMDAR PDFs are grouped beside that manifest.
packetGradingGuide.workingFolders: Whole batch folders are retained. _work includes previous drafts and helpers as well as rev2 checks; grade top-level A/B/C and Batch11 deliverables. The original packet outside the revision root is unchanged. F1 and F7 were revised as requested; old draft/helper counts are not current requirement counts.
packetGradingGuide.transportChecks: The internal package inventory uses exact-byte checksums only to confirm that originals survive packaging unchanged. These transport checks are distinct from the prompt-defined normalized passage, wording and baseline hashes.

resolvedGradingFlags.resolution: Rev2 explicitly marks all 230 F1 records: 227 binding true; the three MIL-HDBK-520A records binding false and kind guidance. Text hashes remain unchanged.

sourcePacket.policy: All five selected PDFs are included byte-for-byte. File-byte checksums are distinct from normalized passage and wording hashes. The implementation guide remains nonbinding guidance.
